2611.13609.o: Byte-level ByT5 post-OCR correction for mixed-script Uzbek text, using an empirically estimated homoglyph noise matrix and conservative Levenshtein-bounded decoding.

2611.12957.o: DocFS reorganizes documents as file systems with aligned tools so VLM agents can navigate, search and read them for complex multimodal document QA.

2611.11886.o: A multi-stage system for the NTCIR-19 DAGRI agricultural document tasks: table extraction, multi-table multi-hop QA, and figure/table QA.

2611.13217.o: Tests Claude Code, an agentic deployment of Claude Opus 4.6, as a grader of handwritten university exams against expert human scores and feedback.

2611.10679.o: Systematic study of how dataset composition, matching strategy and scoring metric change model rankings on document parsing benchmarks.

2611.13752.o: Revisits word-level OCR-to-ground-truth alignment under reading-order permutations, comparing a new multi-region anchor aligner against prior aligners.

2611.08091.o: Introduces annotation guidelines and ATHAAR, a manually annotated medieval scientific Arabic manuscript dataset, and benchmarks VLMs on it.

2611.06449.o: Introduces AmbiHTMLBench, a 1,115-page benchmark for document-to-HTML parsing, evaluated with objective block-alignment metrics and an LLM-judge protocol aligned to human preferences.

2611.10475.o: Introduces WordEval, a benchmark of 642 Word editing cases that checks whether requested edits are realized as intended changes to Word objects and properties.

2611.07810.o: SigDiffuser is a diffusion-based self-supervised framework for handwritten signature verification that learns representations by reconstructing deliberately ruined signatures.

2611.04874.o: A survey tracing OCR from specialist models to unified foundation-model-era systems, organizing five system families and reviewing evaluation and open challenges.

2611.05539.o: Proposes EditVeto, a small veto gate that keeps or reverts blocks of an LLM's post-OCR rewrite, improving several rewriters on HIPE-OCRepair-2026.

2611.03339.o: Introduces ARABGEOTEXT, an Arabic geospatial text spotting benchmark, and a tool-augmented VLM framework combining YOLO26 localization with LoRA-adapted Qwen3.5-4B recognition.

2611.03023.o: VizDAGuide trains compact vision-language models with DAG-structured, weighted supervision of intermediate reasoning states for misleading-chart question answering.

2611.03097.o: Introduces DR Pixel, a page-native multimodal deep research agent that retrieves and reasons over rendered page images, plus DRPixelBench and counterfactual credit reweighting for training.

2610.41426.o: FlexReader is a scene text recognition model that supports multiple decoding strides and adaptively picks a stride per input for a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off.

2611.00242.o: Improves scientific figure QA by enhancing retrieved context with query expansion and score adjustment, plus LoRA fine-tuning of small LLMs.

2610.41360.o: Formulates page-centric visual document retrieval and audits 42 benchmarks against eight criteria to expose evaluation gaps.

2610.41254.o: Introduces BSTRB, a blurry scene text benchmark from real video, and Hawkeye, a fine-tuned VLM that reads illegible text via context and pixel alignment.

2610.41335.o: Pix2Evidence is a multimodal RAG system that fuses screenshot tiles with their transcriptions and uses VLM-generated evidence descriptions to adapt and rerank retrieval for visually rich documents.

2610.40233.o: Extracts parallel bitext from archival linguistic documentation using OCR and a VLM, then uses it to bootstrap translation for 20 extremely low-resource languages.

2610.39308.o: Unlimited OCR 2 is a document parsing model using sparse sliding-window attention to keep per-step cost constant over hundred-page documents.

2610.36929.o: Presents DocXEval, a framework adapting XAI methods and metrics to multimodal document understanding, systematically evaluating 13 XAI methods across tasks, datasets, models and metrics.

2610.39301.o: Presents an omni-modal parser with one shared encoder and one unified output schema that converts documents, images, audio and video into spatially and temporally grounded structured records.

2610.36850.o: Introduces uTHCD-C, a ten-corruption, five-severity robustness benchmark for isolated Tamil handwritten character recognition, evaluating nine CNN and transformer architectures.

2610.38924.o: Introduces TreasuryQA Bench, 70 questions over 1,435 scanned Treasury PDFs that agents must search and OCR via MCP servers to return exact figures.

2610.36759.o: DocSkill is an agentic framework with a learned skill-orchestration policy, trained via MCTS-derived SFT and DPO, plus a new multilingual multi-hop document QA benchmark.

2610.36956.o: Tests how nineteenth-century regesta and editions can bootstrap and steer handwritten text recognition for untranscribed papal registers.

2610.35240.o: An end-to-end framework coupling vision-based layout segmentation and multi-script OCR with an agentic RAG pipeline for degraded, multi-column Indian legislative archives.

2610.35542.o: HyperDoc is a document RAG framework that builds a document hypergraph and performs budget-aware hyperedge selection to pick compact multimodal evidence for long-context document QA.

2610.34879.o: LayoutMamba is a hybrid sparse-attention Transformer and Mamba framework for efficient document layout analysis, with a Geometric Overlap Penalty Loss.

2610.32463.o: Layer-wise probing of vision encoders shows cross-modal text-concept alignment emerges only in the deepest layers, after unimodal recognition.

2610.36444.o: RouteDRAG learns to decide when to invoke an agent and how to control its execution for multimodal document RAG, improving accuracy while cutting agent calls.

2610.34148.o: Introduces MuSTEL, a 14.5M-image synthetic multilingual (Persian, Arabic, English) text-line OCR dataset with train and test splits.

2610.36540.o: Builds a frugal smartphone-to-records pipeline with CPU-only Kraken handwriting recognition for Chadian civil-status registers and reports feasibility results.

2610.35085.o: Trains end-to-end HTR on unaligned edition drafts via forced alignment to transcribe and expand abbreviated Latin in Pope Honorius III's registers.

2610.32423.o: A training-free, inference-time self-correction loop lets a single VLM act as generator, critic and refiner to improve table VQA.

2610.31385.o: A task-centric survey of long-document visual question answering, decomposing it into parsing, evidence retrieval, generator organization, and evaluation with a taxonomy and future directions.

2611.09953.o: Introduces Confusion-Adaptive Margin Learning, a pair-specific cosine margin objective, and tests it against a matched CNN baseline on EMNIST Letters.

2610.30863.o: Tests adaptive cross-spectral fusion and edge guidance in a multi-branch cGAN for multispectral historical document binarization, comparing nine configurations.

2611.00092.o: OCRia-1 is a 4B VLM for document parsing that preserves table structure, chart data and text formatting, trained with curated data and RLVR.

2610.30072.o: Probes whether charts can act as internal epistemic actions in data-agent reasoning loops, and proposes a method that distils experience to teach agents when to use charts.

2610.30026.o: Shows that document converters silently drop author formatting cues, making enterprise agents confidently wrong, and that preserving and typing cues fixes it cheaply.

2610.29523.o: Introduces pplx-embed-v2-late, 0.6B and 9B multilingual multimodal late-interaction embedding models distilled from an 18B teacher for text, image and visual document retrieval.

2610.29188.o: Introduces a table-structure taxonomy, the STB synthetic benchmark, and LTEM, a minimal Markdown extension encoding spans and hierarchical headers for LLM table understanding.

2610.28282.o: ChartEvo is a recursive self-improvement framework that evolves skills, tools and tool-call chains so chart agents handle long-tail chart types better.

2610.33066.o: OvisOCR3 is a 0.8B model unifying document parsing, OCR, KIE, figure captioning and cross-page table reconstruction, trained via distillation and RL.

2610.28899.o: Replaces Smashcima's hard-coded glyph positioning rules with empirical statistics and a GNN, improving synthetic handwritten music scores and downstream OMR.

2610.27829.o: GARRET trains a region-level visual document retriever from (page, question, answer) triplets using differentiable generative feedback, and introduces the ViDoRe-V3-Region benchmark.

2610.28171.o: DocLayout-YOLO is a real-time document layout detector combining synthetic pretraining data with page-axis attention for heterogeneous documents.

2610.28957.o: Compares 11 retrieval configurations, including full-document scanning and hybrid retrieval, on long-document QA for evidence coverage, answer quality and cost.

2610.27592.o: Proposes TextRIRO, a diffusion-based scene text editing baseline trained only on self-paired real data via shuffling and cropping, plus a 3M long-text recognition dataset.

2610.30177.o: FlexVDR learns query-adaptive budget allocation over encoder depth, embedding width and token count within a single visual document retriever.

2610.27309.o: Studies saliency-guided augmentation variants for low-resource handwritten character recognition and proposes an explainability consistency metric to evaluate them.

2610.25440.o: Adapts small vision-language models for Lakota archival OCR post-correction and studies practical low-resource design facets.

2610.26362.o: Presents GAIDA, a modular human-in-the-loop annotation prototype combining OCR, LLM pre-annotation and human validation, with a stage-specific study and an Arabic receipt dataset.

2611.00078.o: Builds end-to-end OCR for an unsupported low-resource script using only an unannotated text corpus and digital fonts, demonstrated on Kashmiri.

2610.24822.o: Empirical study and open benchmark of multimodal RAG for page-level QA over visually rich financial documents.

2610.24060.o: A generative diffusion approach with language-guided visual attention recovers erased under-text in palimpsests and recognizes it with a fine-tuned handwriting network.

2610.25235.o: Compares cloud and self-hosted OCR systems on Arabic, English and French documents for bounding box detection, text recognition and math expression recognition.

2610.23374.o: MOSS-Image is an open text-to-image system combining a 5B diffusion transformer with an agentic prompt-enhancement module, plus two new benchmarks for text-rich and layout-rich generation.

2610.21979.o: Introduces P2TPO, a structure-aligned page-to-token credit assignment framework for reinforcement-learning-based full-page document parsing.

2610.22726.o: A character-level post-processing framework uses binary classifiers to verify and correct visually similar characters in OCR output.

2610.20964.o: Introduces VELD-QA, a 15,000-question benchmark over 5,859 long PDFs with visual evidence annotations, and analyzes VLM and retrieval/agentic systems on it.

2610.21318.o: Shows retrieved pages are underused by multimodal document RAG generators and proposes LoC, which feeds higher-resolution pages plus OCR of query-relevant regions.

2610.21300.o: Shows that commercial LLM deployments give varying medical device document assessments, and builds a fully deterministic pipeline that returns byte-identical output across reruns.

2610.21327.o: DocPilot is an agentic framework for long visual document QA that orchestrates page navigation and fine-grained evidence localization, with curriculum training to teach small models this behavior.

2610.20367.o: SCOUT is a cascaded two-track visual document retrieval framework combining a lightweight visual filter, multi-vector reranking, and semantic summary retrieval fused via cross-modal query refinement.

2610.18763.o: LayerCanvas generates editable infographics by keeping SVG as the structural and typographic program while diffusion aestheticizes non-text content in z-ordered parallel layer streams.

2610.20335.o: Introduces Read-Parse-Describe, a unified document parsing dataset requiring ordered layout elements with alt-text descriptions, plus a plug-and-play space-awareness enhancer for VLMs.

2610.17937.o: MERIT is a three-stage framework that teaches models to reason over table images by adapting a table-specific encoder, fine-tuning evidence selection, and refining with reinforcement learning.

2610.20461.o: Introduces semCER, a severity-weighted character error rate that charges each grapheme edit by how damaging an LLM judge deems it.

2610.18507.o: Introduces TrialPD-Bench for clinical trial protocol digitization and TrialScribe, a domain-specific coding-agent harness with task skills and a verification loop.

2610.18238.o: A VLM framework incrementally reconstructs document heading hierarchies using a level-wise multimodal memory of anchor-selected prior pages, plus a new benchmark.

2610.17530.o: Proposes a density-aware two-phase token pruning method for VLMs, covering prefill bipartite merge and decode KV eviction, with a critique of prefill-only evaluation.

2610.17448.o: TableVision recovers and verifies table structure from degraded historical registers by segmenting volumes into blocks and gating columns with an exact-total sum check.

2610.17057.o: Introduces VL-DocIR, a page-level benchmark for evidence-complete visual long-document retrieval spanning single-page, multi-page and cross-document evidence.

2610.16956.o: DDVR-Net decouples glyph structure from degradation and uses visibility-guided contextual restoration for historical document recognition, plus a low-resource multilingual benchmark.

2610.14531.o: Introduces LongHisDoc, the first benchmark for Chinese long historical document understanding, with 1,012 QA pairs over 101 full-book PDFs, plus LVLM, LLM and RAG evaluations.

2610.14196.o: Learns a global linear correction, distilled from the uncompressed model's scores, to recover late-interaction retrieval quality lost to document-vector compression.

2610.13502.o: Stride is a multi-agent evolutionary refinement framework that routes global versus local edits to fix infographic generation constraints over any frozen generator.

2610.15728.o: Introduces AR-AWM, a white-box attack that optimizes watermark-shaped pixel supports to degrade end-to-end document-understanding VLMs while staying visually legible.

2610.12823.o: Introduces MisVisAgentBench, a paired clean-misleading chart benchmark showing misleading visualizations cut web agent success by over 34 points.

2610.12363.o: Introduces HANS, a handwritten answer-sheet dataset with noisy hybrid content, and NA-GOT, a two-stage noise-suppression parsing framework.

2610.11818.o: Compares eight open-source lightweight VLMs (up to 7B) for OCR-to-structured-JSON extraction on three university heritage collections.

2610.13128.o: KnowForge splits open-domain multimodal document QA into a search-only Locator agent, a bridge judge, and a read-only Deep Reader agent over a knowledge-point index.

2610.11286.o: Studies how rendered scene text leaks semantics into image generation, analyzes the leakage, and proposes a preliminary mitigation on FLUX-2-dev.

2610.33004.o: Evaluates OCR systems on historical documents using entity-level error analysis alongside character error rates, on an annotated Berrutti Archive benchmark.

2610.11553.o: EVIE is a family of native visual document retrievers combining evidence-judged data governance, bidirectional distillation with Prefix-MRL, and hierarchical index compression for efficient, accurate retrieval.

2610.11148.o: SP-DocReader is a self-play OCR framework that targets residual errors left after supervised fine-tuning by masking and supervising token-level reading discrepancies.

2610.23929.o: Compresses visual document retrieval tokens via an Unbalanced Optimal Transport framework balancing importance, redundancy and coverage.

2610.09439.o: Presents an end-to-end pipeline for Brahmi inscription understanding—image restoration, OCR, transliteration, and Prakrit-to-English translation—plus two new datasets.

2610.09177.o: Compares VLM-teacher supervision signals for visual document retrieval, finding teacher-judged hard negatives and score distillation beat positive-side enrichment.

2610.01499.o: Introduces VTR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating visual text rendering in generated videos, plus a keyframe-guided agentic framework to improve it.

2610.01191.o: Segments words from smartphone-captured handwritten Bangla text images regardless of paper and ink color, using adaptive thresholding and dilation.

2610.08170.o: Audits redundant visual-evidence reuse in agentic VLM pipelines and proposes SharedVisCache, a contract-aware reuse hook that certifies repeated touches as reusable.

2610.08106.o: ChartBmkAgent builds targeted Chart QA benchmark samples from sparse error-taxonomy specs using a harness-governed multi-agent pipeline.

2610.00374.o: FECA makes chart generation in multimodal deep research adapt visual frames to retrieved evidence, improving numerical fidelity.

2610.01134.o: Trains and ensembles object detection models to recognize handwritten Bangla words, adding a modified Non-Maximum Suppression and a custom dataset.

2610.20632.o: MeddeX combines a QLoRA fine-tuned LLaMA-3 8B with RAG and Gemini Vision to produce evidence-backed summaries of medical reports.

2609.40356.o: Introduces ViTeX-Bench, a benchmark with dataset and three-axis protocol for video scene text editing, plus a reference editor ViTeX-Edit-14B.

2610.00315.o: A retrieval-guided, glyph-aware restoration framework that uses retrieved glyph exemplars as structural guidance to restore degraded low-resource Manchu historical documents.

2609.38781.o: Introduces ChartDensity-Bench, a benchmark evaluating MLLMs on structured numerical reconstruction from compound chart figures under controlled visual density.

2609.39013.o: EVICALC, a system for the DocSem shared task, reads PDFs, selects evidence passages, and computes answers via LLM-written arithmetic expressions, with failure analysis.

2609.39380.o: InfoAgent is a training-free framework that generates evidence-grounded infographics as visual-symbolic programs and repairs them with dependency-aware, localized edits.

2609.38642.o: Introduces ChartRevise, a dataset and reference-free evaluation protocol for exact code-based chart editing, plus fine-tuning gains.

2609.38636.o: STEPS is a diffusion model for scene text editing that replaces text in images while preserving the original style via a content-independent style encoder.

2609.38282.o: GAD-RL adaptively gates and attenuates on-policy distillation from a frozen teacher during RL post-training to improve OCR transcription faithfulness in vision-language models.

2609.37712.o: Presents PolyOCR, unified OCR foundation models with a data engine and competence-guided policy optimization, plus a revised OCRBench v2.1.

2609.37755.o: Tests how much character error rate four papyrological tasks tolerate, using degraded editions of Greek papyri as simulated HTR output.

2609.37195.o: Explores in-context learning with pre-trained VLMs to transcribe handwritten text without parameter updates, testing in-domain and cross-domain settings.

2609.35473.o: Compares six self-supervised pretraining methods for handwritten text recognition, showing pixel-reconstruction objectives win because discriminative signal lies in high-variance pixel directions.

2609.35304.o: Studies how modality-aware retrieval and edge-level evidence filtering affect multimodal GraphRAG question answering over documents.

2609.36136.o: Introduces Xiaomi-OCR-0, a 0.8B OCR-specific vision-language model for document parsing and OCR-centric understanding, trained on a large auto-built corpus.

2609.34841.o: CPSE calibrates an existing extraction schema's field semantics from a few annotated scientific PDFs while preserving its structural contract.

2609.34899.o: ColNanoVDR distills multi-vector visual document retrieval query encoders into small text-only students using document-free optimal-transport alignment of query tokens.

2609.34781.o: Introduces SceneFaith, a 781-image benchmark measuring how often VLMs rewrite scene text to match misleading context instead of transcribing it literally.

2609.33758.o: Introduces GutenDoc, a dataset of compound-degraded document images, and a unified single-network framework that jointly corrects geometric and photometric distortions.

2609.34776.o: Studies five RAG variants on French PDF questions, evaluating both answers and supporting page retrieval against a BM25 baseline.

2609.33447.o: Parses clinical guideline PDF pages into typed structural elements and retrieves structure-aware evidence units, beating text-chunk and visual-RAG baselines.

2609.33286.o: Introduces InfoEdit, a 1,000-infographic benchmark with 4,000 editing instructions and a reflow-aware protocol to test global layout reasoning in infographic editing.

2609.32895.o: PILAR represents document evidence as a page-grounded entity-linked assertion graph to improve open-domain QA over multimodal corpora.

2609.33322.o: SHED is a two-stage workflow that infers robust, compact hierarchical section structures from documents to make LLM agents cheaper and more accurate.

2609.32660.o: InterTab interleaves chain-of-thought reasoning with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions, trained on a new 22K trajectory dataset.

2609.32477.o: A self-supervised framework that back-tracks high-confidence text detections through video to synthesize pseudo-labels for training distant-text detectors, plus a new dataset.

2609.32513.o: Adapts a handwritten math expression recognizer to individual writers via fine-tuning and evaluates it on small author-specific datasets with statistical tests.

2609.32041.o: Survey formalizing persistent, evidence-grounded document state as a framework, auditing ten benchmarks for statefulness and proposing a longitudinal harness with five metrics.

2609.31403.o: Builds DecoyBench, 300 two-layer typographic images, and shows six closed-source VLMs read only the sharp contour text layer, not the soft shading layer.

2609.31341.o: Studies accuracy-energy trade-offs of small local text-only and vision-language extraction pipelines across document layouts, giving deployment guidelines.

2609.27688.o: Q-REACT adapts visual document retrieval at test time by learning a low-rank query-side transformation that distills reranker feedback into reusable query embeddings.

2609.29933.o: Empirical study of VLM pipeline choices—input format, retrieval modality, and agentic vs static—for long-document QA.

2609.28857.o: A two-stage scene text spotting pipeline fusing six frozen vision encoders for polygon mask detection and a LoRA-tuned Qwen3-VL-8B for recognition.

2609.27678.o: Evaluates Jev and nine language models on ContractNLI with repeated requests to see whether decisions, not just accuracy, stay stable.

2609.26638.o: GravityOCR is a parameter-shared AR-block-diffusion OCR model that drafts tokens in parallel and verifies them with causal AR decoding for faster document OCR.

2609.26381.o: Adds a lightweight CPU layout detector to GROBID, routing figure, table and paratext tokens to specialised models or discarding them.

2609.24210.o: Introduces ChartJudgeBench, a vision-language benchmark evaluating LMM judges on pairwise chart comparison and Accept/Reject verification for chart-to-code workflows.

2609.24172.o: Introduces LegendBench, a parametric benchmark and generation pipeline with counterfactual legend interventions to diagnose VLM legend understanding and guide targeted fine-tuning.

2609.24220.o: D-RAC normalizes any enterprise document to PDF, converts pages to retrieval-optimized Markdown with one multimodal LLM pass, then chunks deterministically via ID-addressable units.

2609.24058.o: Builds a 10M-image synthetic multilingual scene-text dataset and a script-aware Mixture-of-Experts recognizer that beats per-language and VLM baselines.

2609.24092.o: DocMIDE fine-tunes compact VLMs with a plan-retrieve-derive structure and rule-based RL rewards to extract implicit multi-hop values from visually rich documents.

2609.24071.o: Chart-RVR trains chart reasoning agents with reinforcement learning and verifiable process rewards, decomposing reasoning into Structure, Evidence and Derivation blocks for auditability.

2609.23953.o: Introduces AgentForge-Bench to measure how reliably a coding agent with a shell and PDF tools forges a value in a real filed financial PDF, versus a non-agentic script.

2609.23592.o: Shows reasoning mode hurts end-to-end document parsing; instead detects collapsed ordinary-pass pages and repairs them by projection-based region decomposition and re-parsing.

2609.22916.o: DuetGen jointly learns autoregressive layout planning and diffusion rendering via DeepFusion to generate text-rich images with faithful text.

2609.35796.o: Proposes a deep-learning OCR model with image preprocessing to extract information from Korean-language invoices, reaching 87% F1-score.

2609.21351.o: PrismAlign aligns multiple VLMs with table-logic priors and a Bayesian decision strategy to reduce hallucinations and structural errors in table OCR.

2609.22562.o: AdaMerge is a tuning-free patch compression method for multi-vector visual document retrieval that detects each document's merge cliff and builds attention-weighted cluster centroids.

2609.21595.o: First systematic evaluation of LLM in-context learning for Devanagari post-OCR correction, comparing example retrieval strategies and proposing CharBM25.

2609.21543.o: Mechanistic study showing full-sequence OCR in VLMs reuses textual retrieval/copy heads, and OCR specialization preserves head identity while redistributing strengths.

2609.21018.o: MAGIC is a training-free post-hoc compressor that uses marginal-guided optimal transport to shrink multi-vector visual document retrieval embeddings while preserving retrieval quality.

2609.20574.o: Introduces DocAttriBench, a large-scale benchmark for element-level answer grounding in Document VQA, built with a mask-based perplexity attribution method (MAPPET).

2609.20423.o: WeVisDoc is a two-stage data-centric framework that broadens training coverage then uses probe-based diagnostics to target a parser's residual errors, yielding a 4B end-to-end document parser.

2609.31681.o: Fine-tunes a pretrained TrOCR model to recognize handwritten Devanagari characters and deploys it as a real-time web application.

2609.19417.o: TrioRAG is a graph-free multimodal RAG framework that fuses three retrieval signals over a shared multi-vector index, plus an automotive benchmark AutoQA.

2609.20110.o: Decomposed perception, layout and validation confidence channels with conformal risk control enable reliable straight-through processing of financial document key-value extraction.

2609.20064.o: Adapts the compact PP-OCRv6 recognizer to historical line recognition and compares it with a CRNN and a large VLM recognizer across training regimes.

2609.18844.o: Introduces ReFigBench, a 1,000-figure benchmark evaluating multimodal coding agents that reconstruct scientific figures as editable PowerPoint slides.

2609.18823.o: Identifies OCR attention heads in four VLMs and shows they are general-purpose semantic heads, using a verbalization lens to read and edit image concepts.

2609.16859.o: Measures how many transcribed handwritten Devanagari words are needed under four pretraining regimes, converting sample-complexity curves into annotation-equivalent savings.

2609.17458.o: DELTA extracts tables into OTSL structured text via separate structure and OCR steps, and TARQA is an LLM fine-tuned on OTSL for table QA.

2609.31651.o: Introduces PalmLeaf-VQA, a multi-script VQA benchmark of 923 historical palm-leaf manuscript images and 7,384 QA pairs for evaluating MLLMs.

2609.15800.o: SCoRE is an agent loop for visual RAG that explicitly selects and consolidates sparse page-image evidence before answering, trained with distillation and evidence-aware RL.

2609.15706.o: Measures eleven VLM and OCR systems on synthetic check extraction, reporting robustness, cost and governance trade-offs plus a practitioner selection framework.

2609.14302.o: Introduces E2A-Bench, a 969-query financial chart reasoning benchmark that traces evidence through rationale, confidence and action across 20 VLMs.

2609.15427.o: Builds a conservative image-based OCR workflow to screen South African packaged foods against R214 sodium limits and compares it with a Qwen2.5-VL workflow.

2609.14284.o: Evaluates vision-language models for criterion-level grading of handwritten exam answers, comparing prompting and fine-tuning setups against human marker agreement.

2609.13815.o: Empirical study comparing modular OCR-based pipelines with an end-to-end VLM baseline for text-centric VQA on degraded images.

2609.12705.o: ExpertHTR is a unified vision-language framework for handwritten text recognition that combines multi-task supervision from heterogeneous datasets with a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture.

2609.25055.o: Reports the ICDAR2026 competition on multimodal document VQA across eight domains, summarizing 20 submissions from 8 teams.
2609.25055.rn: ICDAR2026 Competition on Multimodal Reasoning over Documents

2609.11495.o: Studies how to combine synthetic and real word images for low-resource historical Manchu OCR, comparing three VLMs and a CRNN across four training regimes.

2609.08705.o: BGTR predicts cell bounding boxes first and uses them to guide HTML sequence generation for table structure recognition, with progressive training and a synthetic natural-scene table dataset.

2609.08330.o: Introduces MANDALA, a multi-script table detection dataset, and EMBLEM, a masking paradigm that hides script-specific details to improve multi-script table detection.

2609.22247.o: CHART trains a search agent with a rotating harness curriculum so parallel search behavior generalizes across harnesses rather than overfitting to one.

2609.13268.o: Adds a capability-aware visual router, weak-to-strong page selection and evidence threading to a frozen VLM retriever-reader for long-context document QA.

2609.13267.o: STEER freezes a Llama-3.2-Vision encoder and adds a chart structure graph, evidence-anchored step reasoning, and weak-parser alignment to improve scientific chart understanding.

2609.05662.o: Studies full-page end-to-end optical music recognition on handwritten monophonic scores and analyzes how synthetic pretraining affects it.

2609.05802.o: AtomCite is an agentic framework that verifies and repairs page-level citations in multi-page document QA, evaluated on the new DocCite benchmark.

2609.03595.o: Studies which synthetic-data factors transfer to real Thai OCR and builds Wayu-Paxa-OCR-Zero, a Thai OCR model trained without real OCR labels.
