2609.03874.o: Introduces STAIR, a ToC-based retrieval system using a finetuned DSI and LLM, plus the SearchTome benchmark of 18 books across 6 domains.

2609.10572.o: Introduces GraphemeNet, a multi-script handwritten character recognizer that encodes script stroke geometry as architectural priors for better accuracy with fewer parameters.

2609.03181.o: Jina-OCR-v1 is an end-to-end document parsing model for low-budget GPUs, combining DeepSeek-OCR's encoder and MoE decoder with speculative decoding and GRPO rewards.

2609.03445.o: OCR-EDR diagnoses OCR errors by comparing predictions and their renderings to the source image, then iteratively repairs them with a DocEDR model.

2609.02486.o: ViSAR is a training-free adaptive-k retrieval method that picks query-adapted page sets in late-interaction embedding space to cut DocVQA RAG latency.

2609.02349.o: GlyphAnchor adds position-anchored glyph patch conditions to diffusion transformer image generation and editing models to improve text rendering, and introduces InfoTextBench.

2609.02059.o: Introduces DocHop, a benchmark for multi-hop chart-context reasoning in document-style images, generated via a controllable logic-first pipeline.

2609.01575.o: Deploys a fine-tuned 35B MoE document VLM with difficulty-aware data curation, cutting quality-adjusted serving costs versus human and open-source baselines.

2609.02207.o: Introduces LeakageBench, a 500-image document benchmark measuring page-level PII redaction leakage across OCR pipelines, detectors, and OCR-free VLMs.

2609.01316.o: MIDR is a training-free framework that uses a multimodal LLM at index time to convert document pages into verified text fields for BM25F/dense retrieval.

2609.16014.o: ViCo is a training framework that teaches coding agents to replicate academic charts through iterative self-reflection, warm-up trajectory synthesis, and multi-step RL.

2609.00756.o: Tests whether fine span-level and coarse document-level tasks reinforce each other in multimodal document understanding, finding conditioned cross-granularity training helps where joint training does not.

2609.00232.o: Introduces VeriOCRBench, a 1,800-sample human-verified benchmark for testing whether MLLMs can verify OCR task validity before answering.

2609.00816.o: Stratifies scene text recognition benchmarks by word rarity and n-gram novelty, finds a rare-composition failure tied to the decoder's lexical prior, and shows only CTC decoding helps.

2608.30678.o: Introduces OCR-MetaReasoning, a controlled single-image benchmark testing whether MLLMs follow deduction, induction and abduction directions in text-rich image understanding.

2608.30616.o: Introduces CENTURIA, a dataset of 507 Roman pottery records, and shows LoRA fine-tuning of OCR models converts handwritten metadata into structured fields.

2609.00194.o: ReDeck refines document-to-slide generation with step-level render-grounded feedback after each atomic edit, plus a new DeckQuiz benchmark.

2608.30213.o: Proposes a unified CTC-based model that jointly performs Khmer text recognition and word segmentation, removing the need for a separate segmentation step.

2608.30163.o: Introduces DocLongRAG, a 343K multi-image document QA dataset, and Doc-REFRAG, a question-guided visual token compression framework for multimodal document RAG.

2608.29970.o: A confidence-aware ensemble of three fine-tuned recognizers plus long-word lexicon refinement for artistic text recognition on the WordArt-V1.5 benchmark.

2608.29951.o: ColSNAP trains multi-granularity late-interaction document retrievers by spatially pooling patch embeddings into nested compression tiers trained simultaneously.

2608.29575.o: SemTrace embeds a document-specific binary semantic watermark in protected PDFs to detect whether an LLM-generated review was influenced by that manuscript.

2608.29477.o: Introduces MUDDLE, a controlled benchmark that separates the effects of context length and topical distractor similarity on document QA accuracy.

2608.29540.o: Introduces NepScript Genesis, a NAS framework that discovers GANs for conditional Devanagari handwritten digit synthesis, evaluated on FID, mode coverage and downstream classification.

2608.28248.o: Synthesizes a Japanese document image OCR dataset from text using HTML/CSS, with vertical and horizontal writing and embedded generated images, to improve LVLM text reading.

2608.28784.o: Introduces ClearText-Video, a large scene-text-aware video benchmark with degraded and restored variants for studying text-centric video restoration and multi-quality VideoQA.

2608.28572.o: PULSAR is a deployed vision-first visual document retrieval system using a pooled two-stage late-interaction index over page images for enterprise RAG.

2608.28170.o: Tests language models and decoding strategies for restoring text lost to lacunae in damaged ancient manuscripts, as an assistive tool for paleographers.

2608.28195.o: UniLipi is a single OCR model trained jointly on 13 Indic scripts to transcribe handwritten historical manuscripts and generalize to modern and non-Indic scripts.

2608.28698.o: Formulates document parsing perception as state-conditioned visual evidence retrieval during autoregressive decoding, retrieving high-resolution regions on demand with a stabilizing learning objective.

2608.27753.o: Proposes PSMC, a data-efficient framework that merges language-specific OCR experts via task arithmetic to improve low-resource script recognition.

2608.26949.o: Studies pixel-level table compression for multi-table document QA and proposes a training-free two-step method that finds relevant tables compressed, then reasons over them at native resolution.

2608.27169.o: Introduces Ancient-Bench, a 2,700-image benchmark spanning 3,000 years, nine artifact media and seven scripts for ancient Chinese artifact text recognition.

2608.27239.o: Offline Android app reads handwritten prescriptions, maps brands to ingredients, and retrieves documented drug interactions and past reactions.

2608.26921.o: Releases AraMS-28k, a line-level dataset of 28,600 annotated lines from historical Arabic manuscripts with margin and insertion-anchor labels, plus baseline HTR results.

2608.26544.o: Chart2SVG is a multimodal LLM that converts raster chart images into editable, semantically structured SVGs, with a new 33K dataset Beagle+ and a Chart Structure Graph.

2608.26757.o: Introduces DEEPCHART, an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 chart-generation instances that evaluates extraction, reasoning and rendering stage by stage.

2608.26500.o: A PRISMA-based systematic review of 97 OCR studies from 2015-2025, tracing model evolution, applications, and open challenges.

2608.25735.o: Uses learned deep hashing as a private shortlist filter with encrypted reranking to make hosted dense retrieval private and practical at scale.

2608.25434.o: DocPC retrieves whole documents by composing representative pages into one grid image, cutting indexing cost and storage while improving document-level retrieval.

2608.25618.o: Introduces memory-only answerability and AWM-GRPO, a reward that makes long-document VQA agents' working memory answerable, improving accuracy.

2608.25140.o: RefLAM is a pipeline that turns historical Arabic manuscript page images and transcriptions into validated line-level HTR ground truth, releasing the AraMS-28k corpus.

2608.22959.o: Introduces WildHandBench, a 500-document handwritten benchmark with a Prior-Driven Error metric, showing top models reach 71.85% and err from language priors.

2608.24976.o: Systematically compares thirteen PDF-to-text extraction pipelines on historiographical sources, measuring CER and WER against manually corrected ground truth.

2608.26192.o: Compares Turkish document QA across three chunking strategies, five embedding models and two LLMs using a fully crossed paired-testing design.

2608.24011.o: SAGE is a multi-agent framework that turns Chinese ancient document understanding into evidence-grounded inference with planning, tool-based evidence acquisition, verification and replanning.

2608.22842.o: FinixDoc is an agentic financial document parsing system with a 4B vision-language parser trained via contrastive learning and reinforcement learning, plus a new financial benchmark.

2608.22366.o: Evaluates traditional OCR, general and Arabic VLMs, and OCR-conditioned VLM correction on eight Arabic text datasets, finding no single approach dominates.

2608.21853.o: Introduces PUMA, a 900-task Polish benchmark probing multimodal models on culturally grounded text, image, audio and document understanding.

2608.22346.o: A data article releasing 485 scanned student exam answers with expert-designed OBE rubrics for criterion-level automated grading research.

2608.22214.o: Proposes query-driven image-text joint extraction from long documents, builds the ITJoint benchmark, and introduces the Q2IT multi-agent framework.

2608.22316.o: Tests whether modern Arabic handwriting warm-up helps historical Arabic OCR, finding the effect unstable across runs and slightly negative under compute-matched evaluation.

2608.22036.o: Deployed CLIP-based retrieval system for seventeenth-century Spanish American notary records, scaling to 13.6M word-image patches with FAISS and Rocchio feedback.

2608.21792.o: HIRA is a training-free, on-premises retrieval-augmented cascade that classifies documents via BM25, dense and image retrieval, an LLM verifier, and selective human review.

2608.21714.o: Introduces LëtzCross, a cross-lingual page-level retrieval benchmark over Luxembourgish PDFs, and compares OCR-based text retrievers with ColPali-style page-image retrievers.

2608.20840.o: Introduces KoViDoRe, a Korean visual document retrieval benchmark with multi-page evidence, plus a large-scale Korean training dataset.

2608.21133.o: ClinX is an end-to-end framework that sanitizes medical image-text data by OCR-based masking plus generative restoration and progressive text de-identification, evaluated on MedVQA for PHI leakage and utility.

2608.20868.o: Fine-tunes a compact 256M VLM to extract key-value pairs from document images end-to-end, with new tags, augmentation, and layout-aware evaluation.

2608.20521.o: Evaluates GPT-5.5-based AI grading of handwritten physics exams, measuring score agreement and Olympiad team selection outcomes.

2608.19026.o: Describes Enriched Text, an open-source multilingual pipeline that normalizes, annotates and deduplicates OCR text from Harvard's Institutional Books collection.

2608.19739.o: Q-Guide is a small agent that identifies missing evidence from a question and calls targeted perception tools before answering document VQA.

2609.22124.o: A resource-efficient hybrid RAG pipeline for Ukrainian multi-domain document QA under a strict 9-hour offline compute budget.

2608.18957.o: An open-source pipeline that detects, classifies, deduplicates and captions visual elements in historical digitized books, released with a 22.6M-element dataset.

2608.18972.o: A modular pipeline that segments historical newspaper scans, OCRs crops, and derives structured metadata, released with an open dataset of 16.3 billion tokens.

2608.18685.o: DocClaw is a unified agentic system that treats OCR, DocQA and KIE as a shared agent-document interaction loop with tools and a structured document state.

2608.18586.o: Introduces OmniHandwritingOCR, a diagnostic benchmark of 77.57K handwritten images across six subtasks to evaluate MLLMs and OCR systems on handwritten OCR.

2608.18679.o: FRAGMENT models documents as typed relational graphs, factorizing structure and content generation with an anomaly score for forgery detection and prompt-based editing.

2608.17550.o: Proposes CADP, a paradigm parsing academic pages into compilable LaTeX plus executable Python, with a new benchmark CADP-Bench and a multi-agent baseline.

2608.17889.o: Introduces VisDocAgentBench, a closed-corpus benchmark comparing static and agentic retrieval over visually rich documents with multi-hop evidence structures.

2608.18289.o: Benchmarks open-source OCR, LLM and VLM pipelines on a high-risk public sector student-application extraction task.

2608.16628.o: Hyper-M2RAG models documents as multimodal hypergraphs with anchor-driven incremental refinement for retrieval-augmented generation.

2608.17414.o: REChart trains a chart-editing MLLM with process-level supervision and dual fidelity/efficiency rewards to cut overthinking while improving editing quality.

2608.17205.o: Studies how vision-language models shift reliance between image and text when one source is degraded, across arithmetic and chart tasks.

2608.16417.o: D2-ScaleAgent is an agentic multi-modal RAG framework that dynamically scales retrieval and reasoning for long visually rich document understanding.

2608.15064.o: Introduces LongDocBench, a benchmark of 85 long documents for recovering TOC hierarchies and typed contextual relationships, and evaluates parsers and downstream QA utility.

2608.15698.o: ConceptFormer learns query-conditioned latent concepts with a vision-language model to align queries and documents for visual document retrieval.

2608.14055.o: HERMES is a multi-agent LLM framework that extracts structured data from ultra-long geoscience documents, applied to the 55-volume Treatise on Invertebrate Paleontology.

2608.14841.o: Proposes Trident, an LLM reranker with structured multi-aspect page annotations plus a generation-side prompting module, for long-document multimodal QA.

2608.12911.o: Investigates relational privacy leakage in document MLLMs during key information extraction and proposes DRUF to suppress it while preserving extraction performance.

2608.13766.o: Introduces ChartProbe, a code-generated diagnostic framework that tests whether training simple chart skills (perception, grounding, simple reasoning) transfers to complex chart reasoning.

2608.12898.o: TeleOCR is a unified VLM framework for parsing digital and camera-captured documents using deformation-aware learning, adaptive sampling, and content-structure decoupled learning.

2608.12133.o: GUIDE is a governed multi-agent framework that turns enterprise guideline documents into validated, deployment-ready artifacts with provenance tracking.

2608.10684.o: Proposes RISTER, an end-to-end rotation-invariant encoder-decoder STR network with theoretical guarantees, avoiding explicit orientation estimation.

2608.10677.o: Introduces Chartography, a 100-task benchmark of professional, domain-specific charts with expert-written questions, showing frontier models reach only 45.0% pass@1.

2608.09536.o: DocPure is a prompt-free unified document restoration framework using degradation-aware structure priors and wavelet-based frequency modulation.

2608.10396.o: Introduces FormStruct-Bench, a hierarchical diagnostic benchmark for table-form document structure recognition with template-based annotation and multi-level metrics.

2608.10628.o: InSight-doc is an agentic visual perception framework that adaptively zooms into high-resolution regions of long documents, trained with SFT and RL.

2608.08732.o: AnchorFold is a training-free focus-then-fold method that compresses multi-vector visual document indexes by selecting high-centrality anchor tokens and folding the rest into them.

2608.08459.o: Introduces Doc2DB-Bench, a benchmark for turning long heterogeneous documents into relationally faithful, queryable databases rather than flat tables.

2608.08512.o: Introduces TIDE, an expert-verified benchmark of 3,050 QA pairs over temporally amended Bangladeshi customs instruments, and evaluates nine LLMs on version resolution.

2608.28635.o: Pilot diagnostic evaluation of open MLLMs on Khmer document images built from the KH-FUNSD collection, testing direct, parser-assisted and OCR-assisted prompting.

2608.07943.o: Empirically attributes failures in multi-page visually rich document QA to representation, evidence selection, or reasoning via controlled interventions.

2608.07067.o: DocMemo is a memory-guided framework that treats long-document reasoning as dynamic evidence exploration, refining page selection across rounds via Bayesian belief updating.

2608.07917.o: TongGuOCR is a layout-aware, token-augmented MLLM that improves OCR of Chinese historical documents with complex layouts, rare characters and reading orders.

2608.07636.o: Presents the first pure black-box adversarial attack on a generative OCR vision-language model, using string-only queries and zeroth-order optimization.

2608.07036.o: Presents CAS2UML, a public dataset of 557 hand-drawn UML class and activity diagrams paired with validated PlantUML code, plus a validation tool for reproducible benchmarking.

2608.06972.o: Introduces the Generative Embedding Benchmark, which tests how much answer-relevant information a decoder can recover from a frozen embedding alone.

2608.06758.o: Injects Japanese structured document parsing into a reasoning multimodal model while controlling forgetting of document VQA, via SFT and DAPO-based RL.

2608.06607.o: Tests whether pre-inference document signals can route documents between a cheap and a strong extractor to cut cost without losing quality.

2608.05848.o: DTRNet decodes text and radicals in parallel for line-level handwritten Chinese recognition with interpretable faked-character detection.

2608.06532.o: Evaluates seven confidence estimators for financial chart and document LVLMs, finding calibration rather than ranking is scarce and deferral is bounded by model competence.

2608.05911.o: An IIIF-based pipeline uses VLMs to detect, read and geocode Western Armenian newspaper advertisements into an interactive map of Parisian Armenian commerce.

2608.06146.o: PaDoc is a layout-grounded document parser that parallelizes regional content decoding over a shared page representation within a single MLLM.

2608.04525.o: DualTSR unifies scene text image super-resolution as coupled continuous flow matching and discrete diffusion over a shared multimodal transformer, without external OCR priors.

2608.19235.o: A design-oriented framework of seven architectural dimensions for LLM agents querying structured enterprise data, with an evaluation protocol and open problems.

2608.03884.o: Introduces BANGLAWILD, a 2,535-image Bengali scene text benchmark, evaluating 15 VLMs and 3 OCR systems with edit-distance and LLM-as-a-Judge metrics.

2608.04424.o: Presents ADOPD 2026, a reasoning-oriented document understanding benchmark extending ADOPD with grounded anchors, captions, semantic tags and CoT traces.

2608.03617.o: Builds a machine-readable catalogue and full transcription of Tsiolkovsky's fond 555, plus a ground-truth-free way to measure handwriting recognition accuracy.

2608.03464.o: Introduces ChartAnno, a 1,200-chart benchmark with 3,600 instructions and a multidimensional evaluation framework for testing MLLMs on chart annotation generation.

2608.03525.o: MinerU-Chem is a chemistry-specific document parsing system that converts molecular structures and reaction schemes in organic chemistry literature into machine-readable data.

2608.03198.o: Proposes a unified online-offline handwriting generation framework that links stroke trajectories to images via a differentiable physical brush renderer.

2608.03292.o: DocTrace casts long-document VQA as explicit evidence graph reasoning, training an MLLM in two stages to produce traceable, verifiable answers.

2608.02833.o: CURV is a curriculum learning framework that teaches MLLMs intrinsic visual grounded multi-step reasoning for chart question answering, with a synthetic three-level curriculum dataset CCQA.

2608.03161.o: Builds an evidence-grounded multimodal knowledge graph from lecture videos using transcripts, OCR and a vision-language model, with a small retrieval test.

2608.01389.o: Trains a 2B single-vector Korean visual document retrieval embedding model with a bilingual training recipe and hard-negative mining.

2608.02969.o: MarginMerge compresses frozen multi-vector visual document retrievers by coverage-aware patch clustering and synthesis, keeping MaxSim retrieval while cutting stored vectors 90–95%.

2608.01328.o: Introduces LongChart, a synthetic benchmark of multi-chart VQA sets for evaluating MLLMs' complex multi-chart reasoning.

2608.01792.o: Introduces ConfBench, a calibration benchmark for key information extraction built from 20 degradation pipelines, evaluating seven VLMs' confidence estimates and proposing the ECARB review-budget metric.

2608.01211.o: VaRS-Doc diversifies query-agnostic document encodings into variant latent interpretations so late-interaction retrieval can adaptively pick the best-fit representation per query.

2607.29677.o: Introduces ExtractBench, a benchmark scoring schema-guided enterprise document extraction on value accuracy, record completeness, grounding and cost.

2607.27902.o: SPaTS spots scene text by routing each instance through one anchor visual token, selected via reinforcement learning, then refining geometry over the full image.

2608.00096.o: Proposes semantic-based contrastive visual pretraining for logographic character recognition, using visual and contextual semantics to handle imbalanced and rare characters.

2607.29638.o: HierDoc routes evidence hierarchically from pages to regions for long-document visual QA, optimizing both policies with stage-wise GRPO.

2607.26976.o: InkShield protects handwriting reference images before release by adding stroke-edge perturbations that redirect imitation toward a decoy writer.

2607.27084.o: Introduces SciFigQual-Bench, a manuscript-linked benchmark for scientific figure quality, plus a staged SFQ-Agent judge scoring figures against captions and citing text.

2607.24651.o: Compares coordinate-based evidence attribution with a quote-and-retrieve language interface, then trains an 8B VLM to quote evidence without region labels.

2608.00077.o: Audits visual-token pruning in text-rich MLLMs by measuring whether retained tokens are spatially traceable to the OCR region supporting the answer, alongside accuracy and cost.

2607.24475.o: Compares traditional RAG with an agentic GraphRAG system that combines word-spotting post-OCR correction and knowledge-graph query synthesis for historical document access.

2607.24554.o: DeCoRAG is a multimodal Graph RAG pipeline that uses cognitive decoupling and semantic-aware cropping to improve accuracy and efficiency on complex document understanding.

2607.24077.o: Benchmarks traditional OCR and VLM-based OCR on Uruguayan dictatorship-era microfilm documents, showing low CER/WER hides semantic hallucinations.

2607.21936.o: A retrieval-augmented LLM framework, ARI, restores illegible historical documents by combining LLM knowledge with retrieved external context.

2607.23194.o: Diagnoses out-of-length scene text recognition failure along encoder-width and decoder-time axes, then fixes it training-free by slicing long images into overlapping crops and stitching reads.

2607.22200.o: LayoutLite is a lightweight plug-and-play module that implicitly scores and prunes visual tokens between the vision encoder and language decoder to speed up VLM-based document OCR.

2607.21468.o: Thinkink is a tool enabling ink-native interaction with LLMs on a shared 2D canvas where users handwrite or sketch prompts and receive ink-like responses.

2607.22723.o: A classification-guided LVLM framework that decouples document-type classification from extraction and uses in-context-learning prompts for zero-shot visual information extraction.

2607.20385.o: Introduces Persian Pixel, a synthetic Persian OCR dataset of over 343,000 image-text pairs with realistic degradations for training OCR models.

2608.00036.o: Introduces XL-DocBench, a human-verified benchmark of 1,519 questions over extra-long professional documents with page-level evidence and typed verification rules.

2608.07527.o: DocAtlas treats long-document understanding as mutable-state interaction, giving VLM agents a harness with search, reading, note-taking and review tools over a hierarchical tree and note store.

2607.18997.o: Builds an AEC-specific layout dataset and benchmarks five deep learning architectures for engineering drawing layout detection and information extraction.

2607.18839.o: HPD-Parsing replaces full-page autoregressive document parsing with hierarchical parallel decoding, using a layout branch that dispatches block content to concurrent decoding branches.

2607.18767.o: Tests whether cropping handwritten student answers with bounding boxes improves small language models' accuracy and compute cost on short-answer grading.

2607.18917.o: TAP-RAG is a task-aware, policy-controlled multimodal RAG framework that routes each query to text/graph or visual evidence executors for long-document QA.

2607.16060.o: ArtChart generates faithful artistic charts with accurate text via layout control, GRPO reward tuning, and multi-expert distillation, plus a new benchmark and evaluation protocol.

2607.15936.o: A lightweight framework segments handwritten and printed text using sentence-level connected components and a region-aware handwriting descriptor with a simple classifier.

2607.15082.o: Two approaches for newspaper structure understanding: a modular YOLO/LayoutReader pipeline and Tiramisu, an end-to-end tiered transformer, plus a new historical newspaper dataset.

2607.15509.o: LLMs (GPT-5, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4) act as closed-loop AutoML agents that design neural architectures for cross-lingual handwritten OCR.

2607.14682.o: Perception-RFT applies GRPO to multimodal document QA without intermediate reasoning tokens, aligning visual features directly to grounding outputs.

2607.14041.o: A multi-expert Manchu OCR system routes pages to style-specialist checkpoints via a lightweight page-level image classifier.

2607.13689.o: A compact 1.11M-parameter CNN reaches 99.73% on 46-class DHCD Devanagari recognition, showing the benchmark is saturated.

2607.13639.o: OvisOCR2 is a 0.8B end-to-end document parser that turns page images into Markdown in reading order, trained with SFT, RL, distillation and model fusion.

2609.17538.o: Benchmarks five open-weight LLMs on key-value pair extraction from OCR-degraded documents, separating field recall from value accuracy.

2607.12857.o: Introduces ChartGenEval, a six-question, corruption-tested evaluation framework for rhythm-game chart generation that reports role-specific signals instead of one score.

2607.13458.o: Adapts axial 2D rotary position embeddings to encoder-decoder scene text recognizers, adding anisotropic row/column allocation and rotary coupling in cross-attention.

2607.13347.o: Tests whether LLM-as-a-judge scores can reliably drive closed-loop regeneration in table recognition, finding them too weak and unstable for candidate selection.

2607.26075.o: An LLM agent that autonomously tunes document processing pipeline configurations, matching or beating human experts at lower cost and far less time.

2607.11192.o: Introduces GDP_pdf, a 100-item professional-PDF benchmark with rubric scoring and a capability taxonomy, on which seventeen frontier models are evaluated.

2607.22679.o: DOSA is a tree-guided, self-regressive framework that infers relations among page objects and reconstructs document-level semantic trees chunk-by-chunk.

2607.11562.o: MonkeyOCRv2 is a document-oriented visual-text pretrained encoder, trained on a 113M-image corpus, that improves five document tasks and serves as a frozen vision encoder for parsing and understanding.

2607.09121.o: A RAG-based system using GPT-4o to generate weekly investor briefs from company reports, macro data and SEC EDGAR filings, evaluated by nine individual investors.

2607.10301.o: Introduces ChartSync, a benchmark of 870 chart-editing triplets for visuo-logical cascading editing, and evaluates 14 image editing models plus one code pipeline.

2607.09068.o: Introduces OmniMapBench, a map-document benchmark of 2,096 QA pairs probing visual-centric reasoning, plus the Visual Dependency Index metric, and evaluates 25 LVLMs.

2607.10400.o: Introduces SynthDocBench, a fully synthetic long-context visual document understanding benchmark that independently controls length, layout, modality and question type to diagnose VLM failures.

2607.08143.o: Reports the HIPE-OCRepair-2026 ICDAR competition on LLM-assisted OCR post-correction of historical documents, with a multilingual dataset and retrieval-oriented scorer.

2607.08014.o: FedTR is a federated learning framework with transfer learning for industrial visual inspection, identifying label defects via end-to-end text recognition.

2607.07179.o: Evaluates 8 open-source pretrained VLMs on DocVQA across industrial documents, infographics and slides under zero-shot, supervised and few-shot settings.

2607.07836.o: Infinity-Parser2 is a large multimodal model for end-to-end document parsing, trained with a synthetic 5M-sample corpus and multi-task reinforcement learning.

2607.05927.o: Introduces a contextual multimodal document retrieval task and benchmark, plus a contextual embedding framework trained with a contrastive objective.

2608.26159.o: Shows that LLM self-generated text recognition results depend heavily on experimental design choices, and that SFT can transfer across formats and bias self-judging.

2607.20517.o: A four-axis multimodal RAG fusion architecture with triple filtering for retrieval over complex Japanese disaster lesson PDFs.

2607.24799.o: Builds a multimodal RAG system for scientific documents using an open-source VLM for table/figure summaries and hybrid retrieval with reranking.

2607.05614.o: Introduces BaFCo, a 200-form multi-page Bangla government form benchmark for layout analysis and key information extraction, evaluating recent MLLMs zero-shot and with chain-of-thought.

2607.04884.o: HunyuanOCR-1.5 is a lightweight end-to-end OCR VLM that speeds up decoding with DFlash and broadens long-tail capabilities via an agent-driven data construction system.

2607.04636.o: SAYRE synthesizes scene-aware document-schema-annotation triples, including error-driven hard examples, to train compact on-device LMMs for key information extraction.

2607.04625.o: HIEVI-RAG is a hierarchical, evidence-driven multimodal RAG framework that decomposes queries, retrieves pages, verifies evidence with a GRPO-trained agent, and iteratively generates answers for long documents.

2607.03836.o: Evaluates full image-to-translation pipelines for medieval Latin manuscripts, finding a simple specialized-OCR-plus-VLM pipeline beats multi-component variants.

2607.03650.o: Releases ClinOCR-Bench, a public 384-image clinical scanned-document OCR benchmark with six artifact subsets, and evaluates VLM baselines on it.

2607.02956.o: Introduces MORE, a 149-language benchmark for evaluating multilingual document parsing, including structural elements like tables and code blocks.

2607.03440.o: An end-to-end archival pipeline using LLMs to refine noisy OCR and add semantic retrieval with cross-encoder reranking and RAG-based question answering over historical newspapers.
2607.03440.rn: historical archival dataset of 500,000 Swiss newspaper segme

2607.01609.o: SINA is an open-source pipeline that converts circuit schematic images into machine-readable netlists using deep learning, OCR and a VLM.

2607.01420.o: Introduces MultAttnAttrib, a training-free attention-based method for attributing long-document multimodal QA answers to evidence, plus the MultAttrEval benchmark.

2607.02025.o: Evaluates five vision-language models zero-shot for Nigerian license plate recognition against a YOLO+OCR pipeline using 88 real-world images.

2607.01018.o: A training-free graph-based method infers reading order in complex layouts by scoring line transitions with language-model signals and solving a degree-constrained path cover.

2607.00734.o: Proposes an edge-constrained fine-grained localization loss that encodes row/column boundary asymmetry into a real-time table structure detector's training.

2607.00747.o: Adapts Uncertainty Herding active learning to cascaded table detection and structure recognition pipelines, proposing two pipeline-aware sampling extensions.

2607.00596.o: Reconstructs reading order in historical Armenian newspapers using a hybrid of semantic zone detection and a generative LLM, releasing an annotated dataset and OCR model.

2607.00250.o: Combines synthetic fine-tuning of Tesseract 5 with five recognition streams and lexicon-gated word arbitration for low-resource Maltese OCR.

2606.31537.o: DataEvolver is a self-evolving multi-agent framework that uses feedback from rejected samples to iteratively construct better training data for text-rich image generation.

2606.29905.o: StrucTab is a table parsing model trained with intermediate structural subtask supervision and a decomposed-reward RL framework, plus a new 5K benchmark.

2606.29808.o: Builds a label-free real-world chart benchmark, shows MLLMs recover table structure but not values, and proposes a progressive training framework for a 7B model.

2606.29648.o: A meta-agent evolves a tool-using document QA agent's instructions so it learns to route among lexical, semantic and multimodal retrievers per reasoning step.

2606.29378.o: Introduces a 1,010-page Sinhala Legislative Acts OCR dataset and fine-tunes three deep-learning OCR models with QLoRA, with LightOnOCR-2-1B achieving 1.05% CER.

2606.27700.o: End-to-end model maps encrypted handwritten manuscript images directly to plaintext, bypassing transcription, compared against a two-stage pipeline on the Copiale cipher.

2606.29213.o: Benchmarks ten OCR systems on Devanagari Hindi across synthetic degradations and real scans, and tests a ByT5 post-corrector.

2606.28780.o: Introduces a multimodal graph-based RAG approach that builds multimodal knowledge graphs for visually rich long documents, plus a document-level VQA benchmark DLVQA.

2606.28081.o: CAPE generates LLM-based natural-language explanations of spatialized document layouts, grounded in document semantics and layout-derived spatial context.

2606.28077.o: TextDS is a parameter-efficient dual-encoder framework for scene text detection that stays robust under domain shifts and imaging degradations.

2606.29130.o: A three-stage distillation pipeline that transfers chain-of-thought reasoning from a 26B Gemma teacher to a 2.3B student for multilingual historical person-place relation extraction.

2606.26041.o: Introduces OCR-Robust, a benchmark of 812 samples with 5 selected visual perturbations at 3 severity levels, to evaluate OCR-reasoning robustness of 18 VLMs and OCR+LLM pipelines.

2606.25935.o: HIPE-2026 evaluates 17 teams on extracting temporally grounded person-place relations from noisy multilingual historical texts, scoring accuracy, efficiency and cross-domain generalization.

2606.24447.o: P-MTP scales multi-token prediction look-ahead depth with a progressive curriculum loss and confidence-gated dynamic drafting to speed up VLM document parsing.

2606.25491.o: Introduces HG-Bench, a 500-sample benchmark and page-aware protocol for two-level answer-region grounding in multi-page handwritten homework, plus a fine-tuned reference model.

2606.24333.o: UniTranslator is a unified multimodal framework that couples translation understanding with text editing to translate and re-render scene text in images.

2606.24484.o: Builds a 2M synthetic WordArt dataset and WATERec, an encoder-decoder recognizer, to advance WordArt-oriented scene text recognition.

2606.25343.o: Introduces Invoice Haystack, a visually homogeneous invoice retrieval benchmark, and VL-RAG, a hybrid text-visual retrieval framework with VLM verification.

2606.24420.o: ExtractConf fuses cross-call disagreement, LLM uncertainty, OCR, image quality and layout into a field-level confidence classifier for LLM document field extraction.

2606.24302.o: Ablation study of fine-tuning choices (contrast normalization, augmentation, layer freezing) when adapting TrOCR to medieval handwritten manuscripts, with cross-dataset validation.

2606.23539.o: LightSTAR splits visual document retrieval into an LLM-free visual selection stage and an MLLM-based semantic refinement stage over top candidates, cutting latency while improving accuracy.

2606.24118.o: PreciseDoc is an LMM trained with synthetic fine-grained coordinate data and joint grounding-reasoning reinforcement learning for precise document element grounding and Document VQA.

2606.23997.o: Introduces ChartWalker, a framework using hierarchical chart knowledge graphs and structure-aware sampling to build ChartWalker-Bench, a cross-chart RAG benchmark, plus an agentic baseline.

2606.23344.o: RT-DocLayout is an efficient end-to-end framework unifying layout element classification, detection, segmentation, and reading order prediction in a single 33M-parameter model.

2606.23144.o: Introduces Koshur Pixel, a 613,078-pair synthetic OCR dataset for Kashmiri Nastaliq text generated from a corpus with a synthesis framework.

2606.23524.o: Ablates a Mamba-based OCR recognizer's hyperparameters and compares it with a Transformer baseline from lines to paragraphs, on synthetic text and IAM handwriting.

2606.23050.o: Unlimited OCR replaces decoder attention in DeepSeek OCR with Reference Sliding Window Attention to keep KV cache constant and transcribe dozens of pages in one pass.

2606.22625.o: DR-Mamba performs automatic inference-time domain adaptation for degraded document image binarization using sample-conditioned fast-slow detail-background suppression gates.

2608.14587.o: A modular agent-based pipeline using OCR, rule-based parsers and LLM ensembles to extract botanical trait annotations from descriptive plant documents.

2606.22608.o: A DETR-based cuneiform sign detection pipeline with tablet-side extraction and line grouping, applied to 87,668 eBL tablet fragments.

2606.19939.o: DiffMath generates handwritten math expressions with a symbol- and graph-aware latent diffusion transformer using LaTeX structure as prior, avoiding positional supervision.

2606.19960.o: Stellar is a scalable multimodal document retrieval framework that filters candidates with MLLM-based lexical representations and performs disk-backed late interaction to cut memory and latency.

2606.19259.o: Introduces TextRich, a 12,095-image multi-domain benchmark for detecting AI-generated text-rich images from GPT-Image-2, and evaluates detectors and a VLM on it.

2606.19782.o: Presents AgentFinVQA, a multi-agent, auditable, on-premise financial chart QA pipeline that logs each step in a traceable packet.

2606.19139.o: Presents the Urdu Katib Handwritten Dataset of historical Nastalique text lines and benchmarks CRNN-based hybrid models for offline Urdu handwriting recognition.

2606.19646.o: SAFE-Cascade is an interactive chart QA system that routes each query between a text-only model and a VLM to cut cost while matching full-VLM accuracy.

2606.19096.o: Introduces PorTEXTO, the first benchmark for contemporary European Portuguese visual text extraction, with native-speaker-verified annotations.

2606.18721.o: Proposes a geometry-aware pointer loss that reweights cross-entropy by spatial proximity to reduce adjacent-cell errors in table structure recognition.

2606.18793.o: Proposes FGSA, a fuzzy-geometry structure-aware augmentation framework for handwritten Chinese characters, plus the LZUSig signature dataset.

2606.18884.o: A controlled CRNN study comparing Arabic- and Latin-script line-level HTR across nine datasets and training sizes to explain the persistent performance gap.

2606.17874.o: Adds a non-causal attention refinement module to an autoregressive multi-task table recognizer, making cell features order-independent and enabling parallel cell-content inference.

2606.17644.o: Proposes Bounding Box Label Propagation (BBLP), a pseudo-labelling framework that re-annotates object detection instances for document layout analysis using only a small labelled subset.

2606.16015.o: Presents Stringalign, a Python library for transparent, Unicode-aware evaluation of automatic transcription models via error rates and error-type analysis.

2606.15987.o: Introduces SCAM, a line-level Sahidic Coptic manuscript dataset, and benchmarks state-of-the-art HTR approaches on it.

2608.28595.o: Introduces a deterministic, auditable spell-correction preprocessing layer that abstains under uncertainty to protect biomedical text classifiers from OCR-like noise.

2606.15886.o: Introduces a dataset of 948 historical astronomical diagrams with 10,940 oriented polygonal text regions and evaluates text detection baselines including a new Poly-DETR.

2606.13916.o: A multi-agent AI system with specialized parsing, semantic and vision agents coordinated by an orchestration agent processes high school transcripts for college admissions.

2606.15906.o: MAGE-RAG builds a multigranular evidence graph over long PDFs and uses an online controller to select compact evidence for an LVLM reader.

2606.12976.o: A forum platform that embeds image-to-LaTeX conversion in the posting interface and yields a growing dataset of math problems and solutions.

2606.11977.o: ParseFixer is an agentic framework that pairs a backbone Markdown parser with selective multimodal correction to recover structured documents from page images.

2606.12898.o: AGAR uses a VLM's own middle-to-late layer attention to find important text spans and re-renders them enlarged before re-inferring, training-free.

2606.13108.o: PP-OCRv6 is a lightweight OCR system with MetaFormer-style blocks and three model tiers that outperforms billion-scale VLMs on OCR tasks.

2606.11710.o: ERN-Net is an evolving reason node network with multi-scale reasoning for efficient document image binarization, especially under low-data and low-memory settings.

2606.10640.o: ChartLens is a dual-branch framework that corrects extracted chart data and refines chart summaries, winning the DataMFM Challenge Track 2.

2606.11477.o: Shows general-purpose vision-language models can read handwritten single-letter exam answers accurately and fairly enough for unsupervised grading, releasing a benchmark.

2606.09788.o: POTATR is a lightweight 29M-parameter image-to-graph model that extends Table Transformer for page-level table extraction, outperforming frontier MLLMs on PubTables-v2 Single Pages.

2606.09132.o: VisShield fine-tunes VLMs with a privacy-focused instruction dataset to localize and mask sensitive text in images.

2606.09435.o: MUDIDI is a two-stage framework that digitizes scanned multilingual dictionaries into a machine-readable lexicographic schema and benchmarks OCR, LLM and VLM systems on a new annotated dataset.

2606.09446.o: A transformer detection architecture with prototype-based line reconstruction learns character prototypes from line-level transcriptions to enable paleographic measurements of historical scripts.

2606.08979.o: EviProp retrieves evidence pages from long multimodal documents by diffusing query relevance over a chunk-page graph seeded with dense page priors and sparse chunk matches.

2606.08858.o: A deep neural network detects and classifies handwritten characters on forms in a single task, trained on artificially generated data.

2606.08781.o: Analyzes how state-space propagation dilutes stroke contrast in document images and proposes DeepMine-Mamba with an Anti-Dilution Gate for binarization.

2606.07401.o: Introduces RealDocBench, a two-track benchmark of real regulated documents for field-level QA and layout understanding, evaluating eighteen parsing systems.

2606.05736.o: VTI-CoT interleaves textual reasoning steps with visual frames for video reasoning, using OCR-based compression of long CoT sequences.

2606.07252.o: Introduces a training-free Constrained Dominant Set retriever that selects complementary evidence on a query-augmented affinity graph for long multimodal document QA.

2606.07161.o: TraRA aggregates recognition over text trajectories using temporal clustering and a LoRA-tuned vision-language model to improve video text spotting in surveillance footage.

2606.06242.o: Introduces a benchmark dataset and evaluation framework for data snapshot extraction from institutional documents and benchmarks open-source layout detection models on it.

2606.05730.o: TextWand is a unified framework for scene text removal, generation and replacement, with a new benchmark, TextWand-Bench.

2606.07661.o: PereStruct parses historical newspapers by combining a fine-tuned YOLO layout detector with a multimodal semantic assembly module that reconstructs articles.

2606.07654.o: MM-Matryoshka is a 2D Matryoshka training framework making ColPali-style multi-vector visual document retrieval elastic in both vector dimension and encoder depth.

2606.05018.o: Builds a pipeline of template-based line segmentation, OCR and writer retrieval to analyze handwritten Swiss signature lists.

2606.04684.o: A five-stage pipeline combining YOLOv8 detection, SORT tracking, and temporal bounding-box interpolation for real-time license plate recognition in traffic video.

2606.04240.o: Reports the design, datasets, protocol, standings and winning systems of the EReL@MIR 2025 Track 1 multimodal document retrieval challenge.

2606.04166.o: Orli is an end-to-end model that autoregressively generates text-line baselines in reading order from a page image, replacing separate detection and heuristic ordering steps.

2606.04231.o: MM-BizRAG routes enterprise documents through layout-aware or page-level ingestion pipelines and decouples retrieval from generation for training-free multimodal RAG.

2608.07478.o: PragyaDoc is a four-layer pipeline for multilingual medical document understanding, combining ensemble OCR, geometric-lexical fusion, domain structuring, and dual-LLM reasoning for low-resource Indian languages.

2606.03264.o: PaddleOCR-VL-1.6 upgrades the compact PaddleOCR-VL-1.5 document parsing model with region-aware data optimization and progressive post-training, reaching 96.33% on OmniDocBench v1.6.

2606.04300.o: Argus adds a query-conditioned region-aware MoE to late-interaction visual document retrieval, making page embeddings depend on the query.

2606.02162.o: Compares four transformer- and LLM-based models on RVL-CDIP to analyze how text, image and layout modalities contribute to document type classification.

2606.01613.o: Presents an evidence-gated multimodal agentic RAG framework combining text, graph and visual retrieval for reasoning over technical literature corpora.

2606.01472.o: Presents HOPM, a hierarchical online prompt mutation framework with dual-loop feedback, evaluated on a real marketplace dispute-evidence generation workflow.

2606.01393.o: Introduces Dr. DocBench, a difficulty-aware benchmark of 4,514 expert-domain book pages for evaluating document parsing by VLMs and pipelines.

2606.01513.o: Presents a guardrail orchestration layer that generates multiple candidate documents, scores them against weighted compliance guardrails, and returns the best-scoring output.

2606.01542.o: Proposes SCP-HNSW, a positional-code HNSW variant with a two-pass query prior to reduce redundant overlapping chunks in RAG retrieval, plus industrial evidence-quality audits.

2606.01132.o: Introduces HakushoBench, a Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers, and evaluates a broad range of VLMs on it.

2606.01348.o: Introduces ChartArena, a bilingual benchmark of eight chart families across three visual scenarios with a format-agnostic evaluation protocol, and evaluates 26 MLLMs.

2607.24760.o: Introduces CHaystack, a Chinese DocumentVQA benchmark for large-scale document retrieval and QA, plus CDocRAG, a VLM-filtered retrieval system.

2606.01050.o: Introduces TextFake, a 20,000-image benchmark for detecting AI-generated text-rich images, and shows 17 detectors/APIs all fall short.

2606.00750.o: Proposes a Paper-to-Interactive-System Agent and PaperVoyager framework that turn PDF papers into executable interactive web systems, with a 19-paper benchmark.

2605.31354.o: Audits failure modes of shared working memory in weak 4B–8B visual agents for document VQA, tracing noise accumulation in the read-write-verify loop.

2605.30235.o: Introduces BullingerDB, a 20,898-page historical handwriting benchmark for text recognition and temporally-aware writer retrieval.

2605.30917.o: V-SPLADE is an inference-free multimodal learned sparse retriever for visual-document search, trained with caption-gated token supervision to ground lexical dimensions.

2607.21617.o: Introduces FaithC4, a multilingual perturbation benchmark, to show VLMs rewrite imperfect text rather than transcribe it faithfully.

2605.30027.o: DocRetriever is a plug-and-play multimodal document retrieval framework with layout-aware sparse embeddings, a reasoning-augmented reranker, and a new benchmark, MultiDocR.

2605.29606.o: HiKEY is a hierarchical tree-based multimodal retrieval framework for open-domain document QA that routes to documents and packs evidence subgraphs.

2606.26122.o: DocArena is an automated pipeline that turns raw document collections into controllable multimodal training environments for document search agents, releasing DocArena-79K.

2605.27978.o: ABot-OCR is an end-to-end vision-language model that transcribes page images directly into clean Markdown, trained with a data engine and structure-constrained reinforcement learning.

2605.27750.o: Compares open-weight VLMs with traditional OCR on Ancient Greek editions, using image perturbations and token-level grounding measures to show fluent VLM errors are often not visually grounded.

2605.27311.o: Chartographer reverse-engineers charts into executable code to generate counterfactual chart variants and test whether VLMs truly reason visually.

2605.27487.o: Builds a Ukrainian handwritten word dataset and retrains DiffusionPen on it to test Latin-to-Cyrillic cross-domain style transfer.

2605.27298.o: A VLM self-ensembling method samples multiple tables per chart and aggregates per-cell medians, plus a new World Bank chart benchmark.

2605.27243.o: Detects multimodal retrieval heads in long-context VLMs by scoring attention to textual or visual evidence, showing they are sparse, causal, and useful for document ranking.

2605.26712.o: Introduces METATR, a multilingual, evolving benchmark with standardized prompting and normalization for evaluating automatic text recognition models, including vLLMs.

2605.26994.o: The paper introduces ChartAct, an interactive benchmark of 673 dynamic charts and 1,440 QA samples to evaluate multimodal models and GUI agents on dynamic chart understanding.

2605.28874.o: Explores zero-shot Program-of-Thought prompting with lightweight VLMs, using Python programs and a chart-to-dictionary task for chart summarization.

2605.25781.o: A two-layer human-in-the-loop annotation framework using cross-model consensus to produce high-precision ground truth for historical documents.

2605.24973.o: MinerU-Popo is a lightweight post-processing framework that turns page-level OCR outputs from diverse parsers into coherent document-level tree structures.

2606.07558.o: Fine-tunes and compares CNN, Transformer and CLIP classifiers to sort scanned historical page images into text, table and graphic categories.

2605.24530.o: Unveil is a visual-textual embedding framework for document retrieval that distills its semantic knowledge into a purely visual, parsing-free model.

2605.25956.o: RAPTOR+ replaces OCR with fine-tuned vision-language models for end-to-end CRC urgent referral extraction, adding a grounding-aware evaluation of evidence localisation.

2607.24748.o: VLD-RAG is an agentic multimodal RAG framework that retrieves evidence pages and reasons across long, visually-rich multi-page documents.

2605.24938.o: SMART unlocks latent multi-vector late-interaction abilities in frozen single-vector multimodal retrievers, improving dense retrieval without retraining.

2605.22413.o: Introduces ReceiptBench, a 10k human-annotated receipt benchmark with four hierarchical sub-tasks, and a two-stage GRPO training framework for structural consistency.

2605.22100.o: Introduces MPDocBench-Parse, a 433-document, 3,246-page English/Chinese benchmark with a protocol for end-to-end multi-page document parsing evaluation.

2605.21090.o: Builds a data pipeline, a 3.2M-sample dataset and a benchmark for scene text editing, plus an evaluation protocol.

2605.19688.o: Shows that training document forgery localization models with operationally sampled JPEG quantization tables improves robustness over standard quality-factor augmentation.

2605.18436.o: Introduces MusiCorpus, a 1,309-page dataset of historical, mostly handwritten Western music scores with MusicXML transcriptions and symbol annotations for training and evaluating OMR systems.

2605.19866.o: Injects RT-DETR layout detections, serialized as DocTags, into a VLM's prompt to fix out-of-distribution document parsing failures.

2605.19309.o: Proposes ProSA, an output-level auditing framework that measures structural vulnerability of document layout analysis pipelines beyond area-based metrics.

2605.19043.o: Empirical evaluation of a single-call LLM grader for handwritten mathematics using instructor rubrics, finding most errors stem from transcription.

2605.18359.o: RAVE adds a lightweight learned query-key bias to visual attention scores in LMMs, improving visual grounding without changing the backbone.

2605.18060.o: Proposes ensembles of lightweight embedded ConvNets for Arabic handwritten character recognition, showing they match or beat heavier models.

2605.18173.o: Proposes SAME, a differentiable soft attention mask embedding module, and SAME-Net, a rectification-free end-to-end scene text spotting framework.

2605.17356.o: Introduces UniPPTBench, a unified benchmark for presentation generation across four input settings, plus UniPPTEval, a scenario-aware evaluation protocol.

2605.17309.o: Introduces StyleText, a large-scale dataset and benchmark for localized scene-text inpainting with style preservation, plus a FluxFill+LoRA baseline.

2605.17270.o: Formalizes scene text tracking and proposes SymTrack, a detection-free dual-branch framework that sets state-of-the-art results on three video text benchmarks.

2605.17447.o: FastOCR is a training-free KV cache pruning framework that dynamically selects a small set of visual tokens per decoding step for efficient OCR document parsing.

2605.17159.o: MADP is a five-agent pipeline with human-in-the-loop validation and prompt fine-tuning for automating enterprise document processing, reporting high automation and accuracy plus sustainability gains.

2605.15523.o: A self-prompting diffusion transformer edits scene text using style and glyph prompts built from the original image, enabling open-vocabulary, style-consistent editing.

2605.14885.o: Introduces Masked Next-Scale Prediction, a self-supervised framework that jointly learns cross-scale feature prediction and masked image reconstruction for scene text recognition.

2605.16535.o: RAPT is a model-agnostic post-hoc wrapper that retrieves similar documents to adapt per-document label thresholds for multi-label document classification without retraining.

2605.14581.o: Empirical study showing single-vector aggregation of visual patch tokens collapses distinct financial documents, with global texture dominance as the cause.

2609.12917.o: Proposes PA-CDM, a position-aware metric for handwritten math expression recognition, plus a perturbation benchmark and cross-metric consistency protocol.
